messages.title: Heads up!
messages.message: A bug is causing false API validation errors. Please ignore this warning; it does not affect AI processing. You can continue using the app normally while we work on a solution.

messages.title: API Validation Notice
messages.message:
When clicking 'API Validation', you may see a false error like 'INVALID KEY' or 'QUOTA EXHAUSTED.' 
**Please ignore these warnings.** This is a visual bug and does not affect AI processing. You can continue using the app normally while we work on a fix. 

Thanks for your patience!
- Team Shots Studio

messages.title: Here's what's new in Shots Studio 1.9.92! 🚀
messages.message:
Thanks for updating to the latest version! 🎉

What's new:

 Features:
• Intelligence: Set calendars, find locations, and search flights based on screenshots (only on gemini 2.5 flash and gemini 2.5 pro)
• Smart Sharing & weblinks: Add images via sharing and automatically preserve weblinks (yeah that's finally here)
• Better Org: You can now group screenshots by date in the home page with a new scrollbar
• Copy Support: Ability to copy screenshots directly instead of sharing
• Localization: Added Chinese Traditional and Chinese Simplified onboarding

Check out the changelogs for the full logs!

With love <3,
Team Shots Studio
